request.brief: The Chemical Cartels, Germany 1910–1918. Shared laboratories and patent cooperation improve industrial research and fertilizers, not chemical warfare. One large period glass retort held by a compact dark iron laboratory stand, broad short spout and pale clear liquid. Base is one plain folded technical notebook with no writing, kept integrated and secondary. Smooth deep petrol-teal circular enamel backplate, sharply beveled cool pewter rim with a thin warm brass inner line. Clean modern vanilla Paradox rendering: smooth sculpted broad highlights, strong black shadows, crisp silhouettes, no rust, grain, mottled patina, paint flecks or glowing science-fiction colors. Large central laboratory subject filling most of frame, opaque field behind transparent glass, real alpha only exterior, small clean margin at 100×88. No text, numbers, gas mask, skull, weapon, modern plastic equipment, flags, maps or decorative overlay medallions.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV national focus icon: The Chemical Cartels, Germany 1910–1918. Shared laboratories and patent cooperation improve industrial research and fertilizers, not chemical warfare. One large period glass retort held by a compact dark iron laboratory stand, broad short spout and pale clear liquid. Base is one plain folded technical notebook with no writing, kept integrated and secondary. Smooth deep petrol-teal circular enamel backplate, sharply beveled cool pewter rim with a thin warm brass inner line. Clean modern vanilla Paradox rendering: smooth sculpted broad highlights, strong black shadows, crisp silhouettes, no rust, grain, mottled patina, paint flecks or glowing science-fiction colors. Large central laboratory subject filling most of frame, opaque field behind transparent glass, real alpha only exterior, small clean margin at 100×88. No text, numbers, gas mask, skull, weapon, modern plastic equipment, flags, maps or decorative overlay medallions.

Requirements:
- Take the frame, outline and overall form from the style anchor images, not from a fixed family form; the size, transparency, margin and readability requirements here still apply.
- Flags and ribbons use invented colours, never a real country's flag, unless the brief names that country.
- The subject is large: it fills most of the emblem and may overlap its frame, never a small figure inside a wide empty plaque.
- A strong central symbol that supports the focus's story, readable contrast at 100x88 pixels.
- Real transparent background around the emblem: no backdrop behind it.
- Leave a small empty margin around the emblem.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a square backdrop behind the subject.

Produce exactly one image.
negative: a square backdrop behind the subject
